data.name: Cli.Help
data.value:
Softbreak NuGet License Radar ----------------------------- Review NuGet licenses with one command: license-radar scan .
USAGE: license-radar scan [target-path] [options] license-radar <file-or-directory> [options] (legacy syntax)
DESCRIPTION: Discovers NuGet dependencies in .NET projects and analyzes package license declarations and embedded license files for evidence requiring review.
ARGUMENTS: scan [target] Scan a directory, project (.csproj), or solution (.sln/.slnx) (default: current directory). <file-path> Direct path to packages.lock.json or project.assets.json
OPTIONS: -o, --output <file.json> Save results using JSON schema version 1. -v, --verbose Show all packages and detailed evidence. --recursive Scan directory tree without selecting a solution. -h, --help Display this help.
EXAMPLES: license-radar scan . license-radar scan ./src/MyProject license-radar scan . --output license-report.json license-radar scan . --verbose license-radar ./packages.lock.json --output report.json
NOTE: Results are not legal clearance or automatic purchase recommendations.
